SYMPTOM: Supersession chain silently drops for all non-global memories, linking logs success but skips project memories.
CAUSE:
1. updateMemory() method in store.ts doesn't support superseded_by field — project memory supersession links silently dropped (only storeGlobalMemory path works)
2. Curator outputs '[#abc123]' but code only strips '#', not brackets — ID parsing fails silently on project memories
3. Rule 3 (semantic tag linking): linkedCount++ runs even when update is skipped for project memories — false success log
FIX: (1) Add superseded_by to updateMemory() method. (2) Strip both '#' and brackets in ID parser. (3) Only increment linkedCount when update actually succeeds.
PREVENT: Test supersession on project memories specifically after any schema/store changes.
